about.intro: I'm a frontend engineer passionate about building fast, beautiful, and user-friendly interfaces. I have experience working with modern web technologies, scalable architectures, and data-intensive and geospatial systems.
about.subIntro: Frontend developer with 4+ years of dedicated experience building modern user interfaces, data-intensive platforms, and geospatial systems.
about.extended: With over 4 years dedicated to the React and Next.js ecosystem, I specialize in web performance optimization, modern rendering strategies (SSR/SSG/ISR), accessible design systems, and advanced geospatial visualization using tools like MapLibre and CesiumJS.
about.experienceSubheading: A proven track record of engineering enterprise telecom platforms, real-time telemetry dashboards, and advanced geospatial systems.
about.educationSubheading: Formal academic degrees in computer science, soft computing, and artificial intelligence.
